rows.item: Group Session: Develop Super Confidence / Recorded series
rows.actual: Variant button reads 'Recorded series (coming soon)'. When selected the page shows 'This format is being prepared and is not available to buy yet.', a disabled 'Coming Soon' button and 'Let me know when it is available'; there is no Add to Cart. Price shown R1 500,00. Could not be purchased, no order.
